source_fit.name: ceiling_lamp
source_fit.scope:
A shared spectral source constrained to a predeclared catalogue cone.

Optimization coordinates are six direct/return responses, but linear cone
constraints require ONE nonnegative catalogue spectrum to produce all six.
No independently tuned layer/halo response is accepted as a physical candidate.
Known source geometry, corrected background, film, timing and scanner are fixed.

geometry.fixture_parallax: Not independently measured; this aligns the ceiling plane only.

source_fit.background: Fixed measured partial minY edge + actual HDR full-measurement body + all other sources.
source_fit.training: Same predeclared equal-zone near/outer training objective and independently audited 19px sparse-P separation. Heldout never selects fit.
source_fit.source_claim: Common nonnegative standard-spectrum witness, not measured lamp SPD or calibrated SI radiance.
limits: Same final-RGB picture reused; no external independent scene/material validation.
Catalogue cone is a finite model family, not all physical light sources.
Camera lower bounds use the already qualified CIE/inverse-decoder proxy.
Physical material response and nominal scan geometry remain uncalibrated.
Old sample/group/radius labels remain conditional image coordinates; updated geometry does not certify new physical annuli or RAW-clipping classes.
Finite multistart results do not prove global reachability or impossibility.
source_fit.inputY_range_scope: Catalogue/proxy-constrained coefficient-sum range at fixed six moments; not measured brightness or SI radiance.

fixed_spectrum_strength_check.scope:
Finite near/outer amplitude-consistency diagnostic after accepted ceiling geometry.

The spectrum, source profile, corrected background, film and scan stay fixed.
Each zone reuses existing target RGB for its own scalar fit. This is not a new
outer holdout, material fit, measured lamp brightness or global optimum proof.

limits: Finite log grid plus local bounded refinements do not prove global optimality.
Both zones and the selected SPD have already used the same final scan; no external blind test or independent source measurement.
Old radius/group labels remain fixed image regions, not newly calibrated physical annuli.
This differs from the historical FL2/old geometry split in several inputs; a ratio change cannot be attributed solely to geometry.
A remaining ratio difference may include source, spatial, background, development or scanner model errors; no unique physical root cause follows.

conditional_source_observability.scope:
Actual-scene source ambiguity at fixed model return-R/G responses.

Two catalogue LP extrema, never a fitted material or an observational confidence
interval. Every spectrum drives all six responses together and obeys the same
qualified camera-proxy censoring lower bounds. Full nonlinear images are checked.

geometry.fixture_parallax: Not independently measured; this aligns the ceiling plane only.

limits: Returned R/G are frozen MODEL moments, not independently measured optical exposure.
The Y interval only covers the finite112 library and two fixed responses; not a confidence interval or bound on actual lamp radiance.
Unknown source shape, sensor SSF, material and scanner calibration are outside this LP.
Similar final images do not certify the true source; nor does source ambiguity itself explain the remaining orange-halo error.

decision: Geometry-controlled refit does not pass orange-halo acceptance. Keep source inverses diagnostic; no current/next or material/scanner changes.
limits: Ceiling-plane geometry does not certify fixture parallax or physical radii.
Source Y is an engine input unit, not SI radiance; catalogue mixtures are witnesses, not lamp identities.
Repeated same-image fits and spatial holdouts do not constitute external source measurements.
LP freezes two model moments, not measured return exposures. Its Y range is conditional, not a physical confidence interval.
Near-white core compression does not establish the cause of orange-outskirts error.
